subject: City Council Candidate Interview Zac Bears
overview: Medford Bytes interviewed incumbent City Councilor Zac Bears regarding his 2021 re-election campaign. Bears discussed his policy focus on housing affordability, zoning reform, and infrastructure needs.

items.title: Introduction and Candidate Background
items.summary: Host Danielle Balocca introduced incumbent City Councilor Zac Bears, highlighting his first-term work on racial justice resolutions and his background as a lifelong resident.

items.title: Path to Local Politics
items.summary: Bears described entering politics in 2019 to address housing costs and the lack of representative leadership on that issue.

items.title: Legislative Priorities and Infrastructure
items.summary: Bears identified his top priorities as establishing an affordable housing trust, updating the comprehensive city plan, and funding repairs for schools and the fire headquarters.

items.title: Equity, Zoning, and Policing
items.summary: The discussion covered the need to reform exclusionary zoning laws, implement civilian oversight of police, and create human-centered crisis response models.

items.title: Zoning Recodification and Community Engagement
items.summary: Bears detailed the ongoing work to modernize the city's zoning ordinance and encouraged residents to participate in public hearings.

items.title: Personal Background and Constituent Service
items.summary: Bears shared his personal background as a multi-instrumentalist and emphasized his commitment to listening to all constituents regardless of political disagreements.
